 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The fun sprint to the finish of the 2026 college football regular season got waylaid Friday due to travel complications by several teams following the FAA's nationwide ground stop .
 Dozens of game times have already changed and one game has even moved to Sunday (Ole Miss vs. Oklahoma). We'll be keeping everybody posted as decisions are made.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Week 11 features five games between teams in the top 25 of the College Football Playoff rankings and a host of other games between ranked teams and opponents who aren't that far outside the rankings.
 Here are the games we'll be watching closely on Saturday:
 Miami 36, Duke 25 
 Wake Forest 49, SMU 7 
 Ohio State 28, Northwestern 19 
 Missouri vs. Georgia, 3:30 ET (ABC) 
 USC vs. Indiana, 3:30 ET (CBS) 
 Michigan vs. Oregon, 3:30 ET (FS1) 
 Florida vs. Kentucky, 7 ET (ESPN) 
 Baylor vs. BYU, 7 ET (Fox) 
 Texas vs. LSU, 7:30 ET (ABC) 
 Texas Tech vs. OK State, 9:30 ET (ESPN) 
 Utah vs. Arizona, 10:30 ET (Fox) 
 Follow along below for highlights, analysis and more: 
 Live 62 updates Featured Sat, Nov 14, 2026 08:39 PM UTC 
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 09:33 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Nolan James Jr. puts Notre Dame up 14-0
 So far, so good for the Fighting Irish. Boston College has punted on all three of its drives so far.
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 09:28 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Savion Hiter scores on a 70-yard TD run
 A big play from the Michigan offense? Where did that come from?
 Both Tommy Carr and Bryce Underwood have played already for the Wolverines in their first game since OC Jason Beck's dismissal. Oregon leads 14-7.
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 09:23 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Halftime: Texas A&M 7, Tennessee 6
 The low-scoring game that many predicted could happen in College Station is well underway. The Aggies missed a 50-yard field goal with two seconds to go before the break.

 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 09:15 PM UTC Georgia pouring it on vs. Mizzou
 This game is getting out of hand quickly as the Bulldogs have scored touchdowns on all three of their drives so far. Nate Frazier punches in his second TD run of the day. It's still the 1st quarter.
 Georgia 21, Missouri 0 
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 09:10 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Tennessee WR Mike Matthews on crutches
 Tennessee WR Mike Matthews is on crutches after suffering a left leg injury in the first half of the Vols' game against Texas A&M.
 The Aggies lead 7-6 late in the second quarter.
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 09:04 PM UTC Nick Bromberg USC gets a field goal
 The Trojans got into a goal to go situation, but went backwards and had to settle for a field goal. Indiana leads 7-3.

 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 09:02 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Georgia leads Missouri 14-0
 The Tigers went three-and-out on their second drive, and Georgia immediately marched down the field and capitalized with a Gunner Stockton TD run.
 It could be easy work today for the No. 1 team in the country.
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 09:00 PM UTC Oregon strikes quick on Michigan
 Dylan Raiola hits Jeremiah McClellan for a 60-yard TD on the Ducks' opening drive of the game.
 Oregon 7, Michigan 0 
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 08:57 PM UTC Nick Bromberg CJ Carr finds Micah Gilbert for a 26-yard TD
 Notre Dame scores a TD on its first drive of the game after Boston College punted.
 Carr, the Heisman favorite, needs to put up big numbers over the final three weeks of the season.

 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 08:52 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Grant Wilson leads Indiana to a TD on the opening drive
 Wilson started in place of Josh Hoover. It's his first start since he was at Old Dominion in 2024.
 A six-play, 65-yard drive culminates in a TD pass from Wilson to TE Brock Schott. Hoosiers lead 7-0.
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 08:49 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Georgia's Nate Frazier opens the scoring
 Two plays after Wilson's interception, Frazier runs it into the end zone.
 Georgia kicked off and has a 7-0 lead just 61 seconds into the game.
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 08:47 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Mizzou gets picked off on the first play
 Georgia's Raylen Wilson intercepts Austin Simmons, and the Bulldogs have first and goal after the 30-yard return.

 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 08:45 PM UTC Nick Bromberg USC misses a FG on its opening drive
 Caden Chittenden's 51-yard field goal bounces off the upright. USC's drive got derailed after a holding penalty negated a first down in the red zone.
 Sat, Nov 14, 2026 08:42 PM UTC Nick Bromberg Final: Miami 36, Duke 25
 Darian Mensah was 30-of-41 for 382 yards and a TD, as No. 7 Miami rolled without Malachi Toney and Mark Fletcher also missed much of the second half.

 It's the first time these teams have met in 44 years.
